verdict.rationale: Intel Gaudi 3 is an AI accelerator chip that runs workloads on the customer's own infrastructure. It does not host or hold user data as a service, so "export all of my data and leave" is a category error for this kind of product. Evidence about open frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face) and open hardware interfaces (OAM, Ethernet) concerns workload and hardware portability, a different axis, and does not make data export applicable.
